outcome: Incidence of congenital nasolacrimal duct obstruction (CNDO)
cohort: 386 children with CNDO born between 2000 and 2008
finding: While no association was found between overall cesarean section rate and CNDO incidence, primary cesarean section was significantly associated with an increased risk of CNDO.
mod_finding: Primary cesarean section was significantly more frequent among patients with CNDO.
